original_test_intent: Verify approved Memory Mirror mode is active, mirrored BIOS/OS capacity matches the platform equation, the system survives required DC/warm reboot, and a two-hour stress completes without errors.
original_method: Operator captures baseline and enables the exact BIOS Mirror mode, verifies capacity, performs an approved cold/warm reboot matrix; agent collects complete DMI/OS/topology/EDAC/health evidence and runs the approved monitored two-hour stress.
manual_activity: Engineer defines Mirror mode/capacity/reboot/stress contract; operator performs BIOS/power actions; agent may collect OS evidence and run approved stress.
required_inputs: Authoritative BIOS Mirror-mode label/value and platform proof method
Approved DIMM/rank/channel placement and installed/protected/BIOS/OS usable capacity equation
Qualified operator/KVM and DC/warm reboot count/order
Approved stress tool/version/workload/2h duration and thermal/power/ECC/OOM limits
Protected evidence, known-good restore, recovery and invalid-run policy
safety_requirements: Require user approval, qualified operator, stable power/cooling and KVM before BIOS/power actions
Capture current mode/settings and known-good recovery before change
Preserve baseline logs and monitor health continuously through reboots/stress
Stop on no-POST, unexpected capacity, ECC/SEL/thermal/power/OOM/watchdog error or instability
No automatic BIOS change, power cycle, retry or recovery
agent_execution_scope: After operator steps, collect complete DMI/OS/meminfo/free/NUMA/EDAC/health evidence after each boot
Run only signed two-hour stress with full output and interlocks
Do not infer Mirror from keywords, operate BIOS/power, assume installed equals usable or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve mirrored capacity equation and missing reboot procedure
Approve platform evidence, workload, limits and recovery
Review multi-phase evidence and issue verdict

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed baseline-to-Mirror state matrix with direct BIOS proof and calculated mirrored capacity at each reboot/stress checkpoint.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Mirror mode deliberately reserves redundant capacity, yet Criteria say BIOS available size equals installed size without defining physical versus usable values; DC/warm reboot are also required only in Criteria and lack procedure details.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Mode specification, capacity equation, operator and reboot/stress policy can be supplied; the pending decision does not block subsequent review.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row41 Wistron-Memory-00024-V002: define authoritative BIOS Mirror-mode label/evidence, DIMM/rank/channel placement and installed-versus-protected-versus-BIOS/OS-usable capacity equation instead of ambiguous available-equals-installed wording; specify Criteria-only DC/warm-reboot count/order and approved two-hour stress tool/workload, health/thermal/power/ECC/OOM aborts, baseline-log preservation, restore/recovery and invalid-run policy; edac-util or dmesg keywords alone must not prove Mirror mode.

review_improvement: Reconciles redundancy capacity semantics and restores direct BIOS, reboot and stress coverage beyond weak EDAC keywords.
independent_technical_reasoning: Memory mirroring consumes physical capacity to retain a redundant copy, so physical installed capacity, firmware-reported available capacity and Linux usable memory are not expected to be identical. The acceptance must name each quantity and the platform's mirroring ratio. Active mode also needs direct firmware/platform evidence because a generic EDAC health report does not prove mirroring is enabled.
